ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

Button.helper: Enter the button to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

AdditionalCss.helper: Optional. Add one or more extra style names to apply extra styling to this button. Do not include a period before the class name.

Link.helper: Can be a local page (autosuggest) or any other text

Rel.helper: Choose the rel from the available options.

CustomRel.helper: Enter the custom rel to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Target.helper: Choose the target from the available options.

CustomTarget.helper: Enter the custom target to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.
